name: shadowbits
description: The $C035 shadow inhibits must SURVIVE a booted session, not merely be set at boot: the IRQ dispatcher masks the register on every interrupt per ROM convention and that mask clears bit 0. Asserts bits 0-2 (text page 1, hi-res 1 and 2) inhibited so stores into those ranges run full speed -- 64 of the user-stack arena's 153 pages sit under the hi-res addresses -- and bit 3 (super hi-res) still SHADOWED, because the framebuffer reaches the screen by being shadowed from bank $01 and inhibiting it would blank the machine.
